name: Russell 2000 (E-mini continuous futures proxy)
notes: Continuous futures series from the free provider: contract-roll gaps are not adjusted. Broker terms unverified. Short free history (from 2017). gap_stress_pct = 1.25 x the worst overnight gap 8.4% in the cleaned usable history (floor per asset class, capped at 25 % because unadjusted contract rolls inflate the historical maximum); min_stop_pct = 25 % of the median daily range 1.83%.
